theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D G : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (ρ₁ C₁ c : ℝ), 1 ≤ m → MeasurableSet G → 0 < c → 0 ≤ C₁ → closedBall y ρ₁ ⊆ D → μ (closedBall y ρ₁) ≠ ∞ → (∀ ζ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ D → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z) → (∫ z in G, ζ z ^ ((m + 1 : ℝ) / m)) ^ ((m : ℝ) / (m + 1)) ≤ c * (∫ z, ζ z ∂μ + ∫ z in G, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ z‖)) → (∀ ρ δ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ρ + δ < ρ₁ → ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C₁ * volume (G ∩ (ball y (ρ + δ) \ closedBall y ρ))) → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ ρ δ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ρ + δ < ρ₁ → (volume (G ∩ closedBall y ρ)).toReal ^ ((m : ℝ) / (m + 1)) ≤ K / δ * ((volume (G ∩ closedBall y (ρ + δ))).toReal - (volume (G ∩ closedBall y ρ)).toReal)
